meta.gate: N>=4 reviews and a confirmed course name
meta.selection_note: Cards are picked within a basket, not across both: a student chooses one OE-I and one OE-II, so a cross-basket ranking would answer a question nobody is asking.
meta.phrasing_note: Cards state counts, not percentages: at N=4 a percentage overclaims.
meta.caveat_line: 104 reviews from 63 students, collected in October and November 2026. Some courses got only one or two, so the review count sits beside every number. Tips are students' own words, tidied for clarity.
